# Vendored from Hermes Agent `apps/shared/src`

Copied unchanged from hermes-agent @ `d62fbea7e1` (v0.21.5). These files are the official typed
JSON-RPC gateway client and the generated protocol contract used by Hermes Desktop.

Do not edit here. To update after `hermes update`, re-copy:
json-rpc-gateway.ts, json-rpc-channel.ts, gateway-events.ts, reconnect-backoff.ts, gateway-contract.generated.ts
